name: Born From Our Blood
source:
Today is August 21th, this date is quite important indeed, since it's Stelios' birthdate ! To celebrate their older friend's birthday, Ryo, Aya, Tae Won, Hibiki and Elliot decided to organized a birthday party for the old barman !

If this day was supposed to be perfect, everything went down when the friend group realized Stelios was nowhere to be found.

What happened to Stelios ? Come find out in this less than an hour long game, "Born From Our Blood".

[From [url=https://arcusnoel.itch.io/born-from-our-blood]itch.io[/url]]
